svg.text: PG-1 wiring 3/10: The gain pots -> their headers on the carrier board
Short wires soldered on each pot, a female jumper end on the header. The pot's row nearer the PANEL is 'l', the row nearer YOU is 'r'. The
header names are printed on the board.
Steps (the number is on the wire)
Input Gain: pin 1 l (RIGHT pin of the row nearer the
PANEL) -> carrier 'in gain knob' header: '1 l' (3rd
Input Gain: pin 2 l (MIDDLE pin of the row nearer the
PANEL) -> carrier 'in gain knob' header: '2 l' (2nd
Input Gain: pin 3 l (LEFT pin of the row nearer the
PANEL) -> carrier 'in gain knob' header: '3 l' (1st
Input Gain: pin 1 r (RIGHT pin of the row nearer YOU)
-> carrier 'in gain knob' header: '1 r' (last on the

-> carrier 'in gain knob' header: '2 r' (5th from the

-> carrier 'in gain knob' header: '3 r' (4th from the

PANEL) -> carrier 'out gain knob' header: '1 l' (3rd
Output Gain: pin 2 l (MIDDLE pin of the row nearer the
PANEL) -> carrier 'out gain knob' header: '2 l' (2nd
Output Gain: pin 3 l (LEFT pin of the row nearer the
PANEL) -> carrier 'out gain knob' header: '3 l' (1st
